Absolutely first class

Can't fault, thanks so much and keep up the good work

Blue Butterfly Restaurant experience
Apr 2026 • Solo

The menu beautifully highlighted every dish with clear, precise images. I ordered one entrée and two main courses: scallops, stuffed herb chicken, and linguine with mushrooms. All three dishes were simply delicious.
I would highly recommend this restaurant.

Our favorite, most delicious meal in Hanoi and exceptional service!
Apr 2026 • Couples
Best Meal We’ve Had in Hanoi – A Truly Memorable Experience

Blue Butterfly Restaurant was hands down the best meal we’ve had in Hanoi. Everything was incredibly fresh, delicious, and thoughtfully prepared, with an extensive menu offering so many wonderful options.

The ambience is absolutely beautiful—calm, inviting, and perfectly designed for a relaxing dining experience. Phanh was wonderful and attentive, making sure every detail of our meal was just right.

The entire experience—from the food to the staff to the serene atmosphere—was simply perfect. Such a terrific and memorable evening. We would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Hanoi!

A great find
Feb 2026 • Couples
We were recommended here at our hotel and so glad we went. 
It's in a busy part of the town (where isn't) and you need to keep an eye out for the sign.
The staff were excellent from the moment we walked in.
We had a table downstairs but one became available upstairs as we ordered, so they were more than happy for us to move.
The menu was big enough for us all to choose.
We all had different meals. All Vietnamese dishes and all were delicious.
We as a group said we would recommend the Blue Butterfly 
With so many places to choose this is a good recommendation.
